mapper.select: SELECT sol_tp_id, sol_tp_tit, sol_tp_desc, sol_tp_tag, COALESCE(icon_url, '') AS icon_url, upd_dt FROM sol_tp_mgmt ORDER BY sol_tp_id OFFSET ${(page - 1) * limit} LIMIT ${limit}
SELECT sol_tp_id, sol_tp_tit, sol_tp_desc, sol_tp_tag, COALESCE(icon_url, '') AS icon_url, upd_dt FROM sol_tp_mgmt WHERE sol_tp_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sol_tp_mgmt (sol_tp_tit, sol_tp_desc, sol_tp_tag, icon_url, cre_usr_id, upd_usr_id) VALUES ( #{title}, NULLIF(#{description}, ''), NULLIF(#{tag}, ''), #{iconUrl}, #{creUsrId}, #{updUsrId} )
mapper.update:
UPDATE sol_tp_mgmt
sol_tp_tit = #{title},
sol_tp_desc = NULLIF(#{description}, ''),
sol_tp_tag = NULLIF(#{tag}, ''),
upd_usr_id = #{updUsrId},
upd_dt = #{updDt},
WHERE sol_tp_id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT sol_ctnt_id, sol_ctnt_tit, sol_ctnt_sub_tit, sol_ctnt_tag, COALESCE(icon_url, '') AS icon_url, sol_tp_id FROM sol_ctnt_mgmt WHERE sol_tp_id = #{typeId} ORDER BY sol_ctnt_id OFFSET ${(page - 1) * limit} LIMIT ${limit}
SELECT sol_ctnt_id, sol_ctnt_tit, sol_ctnt_sub_tit, sol_ctnt_tag, sol_ctnt_desc, COALESCE(icon_url, '') AS icon_url, sol_tp_id FROM sol_ctnt_mgmt WHERE sol_ctnt_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sol_ctnt_mgmt ( sol_tp_id, sol_ctnt_tit, sol_ctnt_sub_tit, sol_ctnt_tag, icon_url, cre_usr_id, upd_usr_id ) VALUES ( #{typeId}, #{title}, #{subTitle}, NULLIF(#{tag}, ''), #{iconUrl}, #{creUsrId}, #{updUsrId} )
mapper.update:
UPDATE sol_ctnt_mgmt
sol_ctnt_tit = #{title},
sol_ctnt_sub_tit = #{subTitle},
sol_ctnt_desc = #{description, typeHandler=egovframework.com.config.mybatis.ObjectTypeHandler}::jsonb,
sol_ctnt_tag = NULLIF(#{tag}, ''),
upd_usr_id = #{updUsrId},
upd_dt = #{updDt},
WHERE sol_ctnt_id = #{id}
